# Todo

> Todo is a free, simple to-do list web app at https://todo.fannycynthia.com. It works in any web browser on phones and computers, and your tasks sync between devices.

## What it does

- Add tasks, mark them complete, edit them and delete them (with undo)
- Filter tasks by All, Active or Done, with a progress bar
- Sign in with Google, Facebook, or an email and password
- Each person's tasks are private to their account

## Pages

- [Todo app](https://todo.fannycynthia.com/): sign in and manage your tasks
- [Privacy policy](https://todo.fannycynthia.com/privacy): what data is collected and how it's used
- [Delete your data](https://todo.fannycynthia.com/data-deletion): how to delete tasks or a whole account

## Built with

React and TypeScript, Supabase (authentication and Postgres database), hosted on Cloudflare.
